verdict.rationale: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas is a law firm offering legal advisory services, so a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a category error for this kind of provider. The evidence shows no software product or API it ships. Its legaltech adoption and the Prarambh incubator are internal tools and startup support, not a public developer API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
